alt: Handwritten definition: Natural Language Processing is a branch of AI that focuses on interaction between computers and humans. Below it the process is drawn as input, then Automatic Speech Recognition, then NLU (Natural Language Understanding), then NLG, then output.
author: NLP faculty

alt: Handwritten list of the five stages of NLP: lexical or morphological analysis, syntactic analysis (grammatical order), semantic analysis, discourse integration and pragmatic analysis. Under it, lexical analysis divides the sentence into chunks or tokens, shown for The cat is running as separate tokens.
author: NLP faculty

alt: Handwritten notes on syntactic analysis (grammatically proper order, grammar and structure are checked; The chased ball the dog is wrong, The dog chased the ball is right, subject-verb-object order) and on semantic analysis (literal and dictionary meaning; The apple ate the boy is wrong because an apple cannot eat, The boy ate the apple is right).
author: NLP faculty

alt: Handwritten notes on discourse integration (how a sentence relates to the immediately next sentence, example John wants to read a book. He picked it up.) and pragmatic analysis (intended meaning, examples I want to buy apple, fruit or phone, and It is freezing out here).
author: NLP faculty
